runs.text: This map shows the scale of solar power across countries using three measures:

items.text: — proportion of electricity generation from solar

runs.text: Use the controls at the bottom of the map to switch between views.
All countries are available on the free tier. Members can access additional measures.
Select a country on the map, or search by name, to view its data and historical trend.
Use the arrow to return to the country list. The
Filter
button allows you to restrict the map to particular continents.
Data is sourced from
Ember
and the
World Bank
Installed solar capacity and solar's share of electricity are taken directly from Ember's published datasets. Population data used for the per-person measure comes from the World Bank.
The only measure calculated by this tool is
capacity per person
All other figures are reproduced from the source datasets without modification.

Data availability varies between countries and measures. If you have additional data or identify an error, please contact us.
Figures reflect the data available when this tool was last updated. The update date is shown within the tool.
